items.title: AI Transforming Cybersecurity: Bugcrowd CEO David Gerry, Live at Nasdaq
items.summary: Tech Edge hosted a fireside chat on July 27 at Nasdaq MarketSite with David Gerry, Chief Executive Officer of Bugcrowd. items.title: Move Over Memory, Fortinet Earnings Show Cybersecurity Stocks Are Red-Hot AI Plays

items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Surpasses Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +20.00% and +8.62%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: The Volatility Warning Embedded in Cisco Stock
items.summary: Beneath the surface of its recent run, the market is pricing a notably wide range of outcomes for the networking giant, a risk you carry whether you trade options or not.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Could Be Pricey After Fresh AI Security Demand
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks has delivered a very large 5 year return, yet the current valuation checks suggest the stock no longer looks obviously cheap, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate sitting close to the market price while traditional multiples lean rich. Palo Alto Networks has returned about 375.6% over 5 years, which sets a high bar for any new buyers looking for further gains from here. items.title: 3 Cybersecurity Stocks to Buy Before Threats Get Worse in Late July
items.summary: AI-powered attacks are accelerating faster than most security budgets can absorb, and a handful of platform vendors are capturing a disproportionate share of that urgent spend. Three Nasdaq-listed cybersecurity names just posted beat-and-raise quarters, and their second-half setups look even more compelling.

items.title: Should You Buy Fortinet Stock Before July 29 Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Fortinet carries a streak no other cybersecurity company has matched, a buyback program that dwarfs most dividends, and a firewall refresh cycle that just posted explosive growth. The question is whether Wednesday's Q2 report extends the run or ends it.
